comparative_decisions.reason: Not selected before Books comparison: Voice Memory keeps a frozen speech corrector and moves adaptation into an external, score-gated memory.md whose edits can abstain. It makes personalized correction state explicit and auditable, but the author speech tasks do not establish safe cross-user memory admission or long-horizon robustness. V2=7/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: StrataCL co-designs transport, routing and topology for supernode collectives and validates selected paths on a DGX B200 proxy. The prototype supports fabric-native specialization, not production fault-domain behavior, portability or long-term operations. V2=7/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: The model emits compact mergeable aggregation state so set-like queries can be combined without serializing every intermediate value back through the prompt. This trades exact raw-history access for algebraic state semantics, merge correctness and task-specific operator support; it fills a gap between token context and externally executable aggregation. V2=8/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: CG-World defines explicit world states, actions, observations, events and branch lineage for counterfactual world-model data. It strengthens state identity and transition provenance, while dataset scale and synthetic consistency do not prove causal or control-sufficient dynamics in a real environment. V2=8/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: DualDecoder predicts which long-context state should be prefetched before decode consumes it, overlapping remote-memory movement with computation. Its gains depend on predictor accuracy, transfer overlap and workload locality; false predictions waste bandwidth and do not change KV correctness ownership. V2=8/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: LLMET couples an LLM-serving simulator to emerging monolithic-3D memory models so architecture, traffic and device assumptions can be evaluated together. It is useful cross-layer design evidence, but simulator projections are not physical hardware measurements or production SLO proof. V2=8/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: HiFloat4 exposes that end-to-end FP4 RL is limited by rollout activation underflow and rollout-to-training numerical mismatch, then adds a residual-quality path. The paper supports a precision-separated training contract on its tested stack, not universal FP4 stability or hardware throughput. V2=8/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: The memory store separates immutable identity from versioned content and records both valid time and transaction time, enabling time-travel retrieval and supersession. Bitemporal state prevents newest-write-wins from erasing history, but requires conflict policy, index maintenance and explicit authority over retroactive corrections. V2=9/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: ServerlessT2I decomposes text-to-image serving into workflow stages with scheduling and data movement choices. Author workloads demonstrate a bounded deployment design, not general cold-start, multi-tenant isolation or cross-model production behavior. V2=7/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: WikiLoop jointly trains a builder and navigator over a persistent agent-native wiki using downstream utility and guard penalties. The loop makes write and read policy co-dependent, but can entrench self-confirming summaries unless provenance, admission and external outcome checks remain independent. V2=8/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: FedWeave aggregates prototype-level experts and trains a client-level router for heterogeneous federated MoE-LoRA. It changes the specialization unit from whole adapters to experts, gaining reuse while adding router drift, privacy leakage and communication/placement complexity. V2=8/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: The paper distinguishes lossy speculative verification mechanisms from distribution-preserving verification and measures speed-quality trade-offs. Relaxing acceptance changes the sampling contract, so matched-policy baselines and quality failure modes must accompany throughput claims. V2=8/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: NELSSA places mixed-length requests across GPU and processing-near-memory resources using a length-aware runtime. The evaluated threshold policy exposes useful placement economics, but depends on workload skew, model fit and heterogeneous transfer costs. V2=8/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: Filesystem memory externalizes agent state into inspectable files and studies organization and evolution. Auditability and tool compatibility improve, while concurrent mutation, stale derived files, authority and rollback remain unresolved system responsibilities. V2=8/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: Controlled replacement of latent inter-agent messages decomposes the value of channel presence, channel content and another agent contribution. This causal audit prevents communication-looking traces from being credited without intervention, while replacement validity and task coverage bound the conclusion. V2=8/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Selected before Books comparison: CheckVLA uses a frozen action-conditioned world model to verify open-loop action chunks, then rewrites a risky suffix under a conformal threshold. Verification can reduce unchecked commitment, but model error, calibration shift and added control latency mean it cannot own physical safety. Its V2 profile 3/3/3 adds a distinct MULTIMODAL-EMBODIED-VLA mechanism/evidence contract to the three-unit narrative set.

Not selected before Books comparison: Ripple streams audio-video generation through a fixed sliding window with modality-specific recurrent memories and cross-modal exchange. Bounded state enables real-time generation, but recurrent drift, synchronization errors and window truncation replace full-context cost. V2=8/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: Recast forecasts trajectory-level safety risk from short- and long-range interaction context rather than classifying isolated turns. Early warning can reserve intervention budget, but black-box labels, horizon shift and false alarms prevent the predictor from becoming the authorization owner. V2=7/9 and it overlaps the selected narrative's PLATFORM-SECURITY responsibility. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: Metamorphic RAG testing mutates a corpus under relations whose expected answer behavior is known, exposing stale-index and retrieval-update failures without requiring a new oracle for every case. Mutation validity and representativeness become the new evidence boundary. V2=8/9 and it overlaps the selected narrative's PLATFORM-EVALUATION-SYSTEM responsibility. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: ToxScreen studies detection and trigger recovery across a large controlled set of poisoned models. It broadens poisoning evaluation, but synthetic poison families and detector access assumptions do not prove coverage against adaptive or supply-chain attacks. V2=7/9 and it overlaps the selected narrative's PLATFORM-SECURITY responsibility. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: TSDS jointly calibrates when an edge ReAct agent should stop reasoning and when it should defer to a cloud model, with finite-sample reward and call-rate guarantees. The guarantee is distribution- and calibration-set-bound; drift, privacy and cloud unavailability remain operational failures. V2=8/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: The study compares a five-agent pipeline with two-call self-refinement on local models and traces format and error accumulation. It shows that extra agents are not free capability, but the result remains task/model-specific rather than a universal topology ranking. V2=7/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: VITAL-RAG represents code as a canonical object with a semantic companion and allocates context under token budgets. Separating identity from retrieval representation protects exact code, while companion drift and budget heuristics add synchronization and recall risks. V2=7/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: The compositional theory characterizes algebraic memory operations available to finite-precision causally masked transformers. It sharpens expressivity boundaries, but theoretical constructions do not establish learnability, robustness or efficient runtime realization at production scale. V2=7/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: The paper asks which physical parameters a latent world model can identify from bounded inputs and supplies certificate-style conditions. It separates predictive fit from knowability, while the certificate assumptions and controlled systems do not guarantee identifiability in open physical environments. V2=9/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: MemSecBench follows memory poisoning through persistence, retrieval, downstream consequence and selective repair. This lifecycle view exposes derived-state cleanup, but benchmark attacks and backends do not cover all adaptive adversaries or production memory stores. V2=8/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: Routing On-Policy Distillation assigns safety- and task-teacher signals per token to reduce template mismatch during realignment. The routing can retain utility, but teacher errors, route collapse and prompt-family coverage remain bounded by the author setup. V2=7/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: CAM-DF learns when to stop acquiring tools by optimizing marginal payoff over ranked prefixes under heterogeneous tool costs. It turns ranking into a decision, but depends on offline payoff labels, ranking quality and cost estimates that may drift. V2=8/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: InferScale injects personalized KV state through a GPU-native path rather than rebuilding every prefix. The prototype demonstrates a state-transfer optimization, but read-only-store assumptions, compatibility and multi-node behavior limit generalization. V2=8/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: The benchmark shows marginal conformal prediction can under-cover rare costly classes and evaluates Mondrian coverage plus budgeted human abstention. Distribution-free coverage is calibration-exchangeability-bound and does not eliminate label shift or human review error. V2=7/9 and it overlaps the selected narrative's PLATFORM-EVALUATION-SYSTEM responsibility. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: SpecFirst makes behavioral specification elicitation a separate phase before agentic code synthesis. V2=7/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: The proposed photonic-CXL appliance externalizes KV capacity behind a scalable memory fabric and evaluates it through modeling. V2=8/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Selected before Books comparison: FAVA lowers LLM-derived permission intent into an intermediate representation, builds an evidence-backed permission graph and delegates decisions to a deterministic SMT authorizer at the gateway. This keeps the model as proposal owner, while policy completeness, evidence freshness and solver availability become explicit failure modes. Its V2 profile 3/3/3 adds a distinct PLATFORM-SECURITY mechanism/evidence contract to the three-unit narrative set.

Not selected before Books comparison: Functional reconstruction trains an MLA-compatible draft path to preserve target-relevant behavior rather than merely reconstruct KV tensors. Better functional alignment can raise accepted progress, but still requires exact target verification and adds target-specific coupling. V2=7/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: SDO organizes post-training data around structural relationships rather than treating examples as an unordered pool. V2=7/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: The study shows endpoint scores may remain flat after quantization while intermediate agent-process failures increase within an apparent error budget. It supports process metrics and slice gates, not the claim that every quantized model fails in the same way. V2=8/9 and it overlaps the selected narrative's PLATFORM-EVALUATION-SYSTEM responsibility. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: AgentS4D evaluates workspace-agent risk across execution stages rather than only final answers. The benchmark supports lifecycle slicing, while its threat scope and task environment cannot stand in for production authorization or incident evidence. V2=8/9 and it overlaps the selected narrative's PLATFORM-EVALUATION-SYSTEM responsibility. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: SIGIL compiles prose skills into a typed intermediate representation and executable harness, separating cognitive instructions from deterministic procedure. Typed compilation improves mandated-step observability, while compiler misinterpretation and stale environment bindings require versioned validation. V2=9/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Selected before Books comparison: LayerRAG-Bench injects faults at evidence, tool-contract, authorization and session-state layers and shows schema normalization repairs only schema drift. The result establishes a layer-specific credit rule: grounded output cannot hide stale or wrong-session evidence, and a repair must not be promoted beyond its target layer. Its V2 profile 3/3/3 adds a distinct PLATFORM-EVALUATION-SYSTEM mechanism/evidence contract to the three-unit narrative set.

Not selected before Books comparison: SkillMentor separates blind-spot diagnosis from task execution and trains a mentor to generate diagnostic tasks and skills. This can focus self-improvement, but mentor bias and self-generated evaluation can reinforce a shared blind spot. V2=7/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: Explorative Modeling factors the training loop over multiple candidate matches and trains on the selected match, making sampling during training closer to inference-time mode commitment. Exploration becomes a third compute axis, but multiplies candidate-generation cost and introduces selection bias; author scaling curves do not prove a universal replacement for AR or diffusion. V2=9/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: Paired robustness tests find diffusion language models are not inherently robust to natural input noise and identify decoder/routing failures. The result narrows a broad robustness claim, while architecture and corruption coverage bound the comparison. V2=7/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: GAMER stores episodic action transitions in a graph with positive and negative temporal-difference values to couple inference-time search and memory. It can reuse experience, but value drift, graph growth and off-policy transfer can fossilize bad actions. V2=7/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: Causal interventions distinguish an agent saying or loading a skill from actually relying on its content, exposing skill theater and source loss in multi-agent settings. The evaluation improves provenance claims, while intervention fidelity and hidden alternate paths bound causal attribution. V2=9/9 and it overlaps the selected narrative's PLATFORM-EVALUATION-SYSTEM responsibility. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: FoMo-FD uses an action-conditioned flow-matching world model to predict surgical policy outcomes and calibrates failure thresholds across simulation and real traces. It can gate risky chunks, but world-model misspecification and domain shift prevent it from replacing a safety controller. V2=8/9 and it overlaps the selected narrative's MULTIMODAL-EMBODIED-VLA responsibility. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

Not selected before Books comparison: DUET routes same-weight on-policy disagreement between two teachers to improve prohibition compliance. The bounded experiments support teacher disagreement as a training signal, while shared-weight correlation and evaluator scope limit claims of general safety. V2=7/9 and its evaluated reach or durability is narrower than the selected set under this window's evidence. It remains a completed Deep Source Review; narrative non-selection does not alter its evidence or later Books duty.

headings_index.title: 2.4 What is held fixed and what varies
The skill setting asks the same question with a harder probe, and the winner depends on who consumes the memory.
Curated skills+mem (GS) is also the cheapest store to deploy.
The same probe on the skill management agent finds a threshold, and it shows in the store.
The conversational store grows inside its files, and curation is not always compression.
Stores get more useful as they grow, at every model we measured.
Accumulation itself is worth points, most where the execution agent is weak.
The cost of growth splits by form.
Early memories survive, and maintenance is where capability shows.
The tool set shapes how memory is organized, within limits that the runs themselves reveal.
Radically different organizations answer about equally well.
The search agent co-adapts to the store it is given.
Sharding’s premium appears on large material, in bytes and build effort, not in dollars.
On skills, the same axis splits: adding a tool changes behavior, replacing the tool set changes outcomes.

Agent-curated store at LoCoMo: a file per speaker plus their shared thread.
Agent-curated store at PersonaMem 128k: one deep hub, one spin-off.
Foldered sessions at PersonaMem 128k: ten topic directories.
Skill store from the gpt-5.4 management agent: a flat shelf of named procedures.

headings_index.title: Transforming Workspace Tasks into Safety Cases
Finding 1: Unsafe execution is widespread across agent configurations formed by different harnesses and LLM backends.
Finding 2: Agent safety depends on how its harness and LLM work together rather than on either component alone.
Finding 3: Task completion does not establish safety, and unsafe execution does not necessarily prevent completion.
Finding 4: Agent systems remain vulnerable across multiple risk carriers, and their safety varies when the same induction strategy is delivered through different carriers.
Finding 5: Agent systems respond differently to the same target harm when its carrier or induction strategy changes.
Finding 6: Agents can complete tasks despite unsafe behavior across multiple execution stages.
Finding 7: Agent systems exhibit a recurring pattern in which assessment and planning anomalies co-occur with unsafe actions or effects.
